kill_criterion: Reporting/attribution deliverable, not a promotion gate (pathway #2 of the 07-08 queue). The verdict must be robust to ambiguous handling: the adversarial upper bound (ambiguous counted as mislabeled) must stay < 30% or the sensitivity is reported as a caveat.
notes: MAGNITUDE LABELS ARE GENUINE 2026-07-08 (Band 3, < 30%; pathway #2 closed). Zero-LLM-call, zero-scorer-call read-only inspection of all 19 dev140 FrequencyChange magnitude annotations (Frequent 12 / Infrequent 7 across 16 letters) against their source letter text (+-220-char context window). Classification per the frozen three-category taxonomy (MISLABELED_DIRECTION / GENUINE_MAGNITUDE / AMBIGUOUS; ties toward GENUINE_MAGNITUDE): 16 GENUINE_MAGNITUDE, 1 MISLABELED_DIRECTION, 2 AMBIGUOUS. Headline mislabeled share 1/17 = 5.9% (ambiguous excluded), far below the 30% threshold; ROBUST to ambiguous handling (adversarial upper bound 3/19 = 15.8% still < 30%; lower bound 5.3%). The single mislabel is EA0049 generalised-tonic-clonic-seizures labeled Frequent despite the text reading "were infrequent at first they are now happening frequently" (an explicit before/after change -> should be Increased). The two ambiguous rows (EA0022, EA0059) both use "well controlled" -> Infrequent (guideline List 11 L877-L879), which sits at the boundary of magnitude (low rate) and direction (has come under control). Co-annotation cross-tab corroborates: the 4 letters carrying BOTH a magnitude and a direction label on different seizure types (EA0050, EA0123, EA0161, EA0049) classify the magnitude labels as genuine (the annotator distinguished the two types deliberately). ANSWERS the deconflation probe (entry 38) deferred question: the FrequencyChange magnitude sub-vocab is NOT a gold-annotation representational defect. The conflation of change-direction and frequency-magnitude on a single attribute is by annotation-guideline design (Appendix L987, "Aligned"). Consequently the deconflation probe residual direction gap (+0.0226) is a PURE MODEL GAP, not a gold artifact. Reaffirms the deconflation same projection for magnitude labels as the faithful direction-axis encoding of genuinely-magnitude labels. No gold-defect caveat warranted for the manuscript; the single mislabel + two ambiguous rows are documented gold-noise at known low prevalence, consistent with the /gold-noise frontend tab surface. Does not change any cited number, gold annotation, scorer, metric, or production wiring. See docs/experiments/exectv2/seizure_frequency/exectv2_sf_magnitude_gold_audit_results_2026-07-08.md.
